pr.title: deref patterns: lower deref patterns to MIR
pr.description:
This lowers deref patterns to MIR. This is a bit tricky because this is the first kind of pattern that requires storing a value in a temporary. Thanks to https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/123324 false edges are no longer a problem.

The thing I'm not confident about is the handling of fake borrows. This PR ignores any fake borrows inside a deref pattern. We are guaranteed to at least fake borrow the place of the first pointer value, which could be enough, but I'm not certain.
pr.author: Nadrieril

analysis.originalLogic: Before this change, post-borrowck cleanup recognized only the monomorphic fake borrow in `StatementKind::Assign(box (_, Rvalue::Ref(_, BorrowKind::Fake, _)))`, and temporary promotion rejected only `BorrowKind::Fake` (plus closure captures) as `Unpromotable`. The PR splits fake borrows into `BorrowKind::Fake(FakeBorrowKind)` with `Shallow` and `Deep`: shallow is the ordinary match/index fake borrow, while deep is used for deref patterns because shallow borrows do not protect projections.
analysis.incorrectTransformation: After `BorrowKind::Fake` gains a `FakeBorrowKind` payload, a pass that keeps matching only the exact old `BorrowKind::Fake` form, or that treats a deref-pattern scrutinee as protected by a shallow fake borrow, is incorrect. In `CleanupPostBorrowck`, such a narrow match can leave `Fake(Deep)`/`Fake(Shallow)` borrow statements in runtime MIR instead of erasing all fake borrows. In `PromoteTemps`, a narrow match can allow fake borrows into promotion instead of rejecting every fake borrow. For deref patterns, using only a shallow fake borrow fails to prevent guard code from mutating through the dereferenced place.
analysis.inputDomain: MIR after match lowering and before/around borrowck containing `Rvalue::Ref(_, BorrowKind::Fake(FakeBorrowKind::Shallow|Deep), place)`, especially from match guards and deref-pattern lowering; promotion analysis for const/static candidate bodies. A focused pair can use the same place and borrow with only the fake-borrow kind changed between `Fake(Shallow)` and `Fake(Deep)`.
analysis.summary: Cross-pass invariant: fake borrows are borrowck-only artifacts. Every fake-borrow variant must be erased by `CleanupPostBorrowck` and rejected by `PromoteTemps`; deref-pattern fake borrows must be deep enough to block guard mutation. The patch changes both passes from matching the old exact `BorrowKind::Fake` to matching `BorrowKind::Fake(_)`.
analysis.trigger: Introducing or processing multiple fake-borrow kinds, particularly when lowering deref patterns to MIR and when running post-borrowck cleanup or const promotion on MIR containing fake borrows.
preconditions: The MIR contains `Rvalue::Ref` with a fake borrow kind.
`CleanupPostBorrowck` runs after borrowck and must remove all fake borrows before runtime MIR.
Promotion analysis encounters a body/place borrowed with a fake borrow and must not promote it.
A deref pattern is used in a match with a guard that can mutate through the scrutinee.
pitfalls: Matching only `BorrowKind::Fake` after the enum gains a payload is too narrow; use `BorrowKind::Fake(_)` in cleanup and promotion.
Do not treat deep fake borrows as ordinary promotable shared borrows merely because they are immutable/aliasable-looking.
A shallow fake borrow only protects the immediately borrowed place, not its projections; deref patterns need a deep fake borrow to reject guard mutation such as `*b = true`.
The `SimplifyCfg` MIR-test hunks in this patch mainly renumber locals and print `fake shallow`; they are not evidence of a separate `SimplifyCfg` semantic rewrite.
analysis.testStrategy: Add UI coverage for deref patterns under match guards: `tests/ui/pattern/deref-patterns/fake_borrows.rs` expects `E0510: cannot assign `*b` in match guard` when the guard writes through the dereferenced box. Keep run-pass deref-pattern tests for branch/bindings. Add MIR tests that contain both `Fake(Shallow)` and `Fake(Deep)` borrows and check `CleanupPostBorrowck` replaces both the fake-borrow assignments and `FakeRead(ForMatchGuard, ...)` uses with `nop` (the existing `tests/mir-opt/remove_fake_borrows.match_guard.CleanupPostBorrowck.*.diff` shows this). Add a promotion-focused check that both fake-borrow kinds are rejected, since the supplied patch does not show a dedicated `PromoteTemps` regression test.
evidence: /// A shared shallow borrow. The immediately borrowed place must be immutable, but projections
/// A shared (deep) borrow. Data must be immutable and is aliasable.
This is used when lowering deref patterns, where shallow borrows wouldn't prevent something
